name: Bound Ledger
desc: Small basic construct. Slashing attacks. Takes 25% less piercing and 50% more heat damage. Appears in the Long Hall.

name: Filing Automaton
desc: Basic construct, armour 2. Strikes with a filing arm for bludgeoning damage. Takes 20% less slashing and piercing, 20% more bludgeoning and 50% more lightning damage. Appears in the Long Hall. Drops iron scrap.

name: Sorting Automaton
desc: Basic construct, quick. Slashes with sorting blades. Takes 20% less slashing and piercing, 20% more bludgeoning and 50% more lightning damage. Appears in the Long Hall. Drops iron scrap.

name: Living Doll
desc: Small basic construct, dark element. Stabs for piercing damage. Takes 30% less dark damage. Appears in the Long Hall.

name: The Puppet Bureaucrat
desc: Large elite construct, dark element, on three strings. Always fights alone. Strikes for bludgeoning damage. Takes 30% less slashing, piercing and dark damage, 35% more bludgeoning and 20% more heat. Level 12 with all three strings; each string anchor cut on the floor above takes a level off. Appears in the Hearing Room. 200 XP; rare drop: Lucky Charm.

name: The Toll Collector
desc: Large basic construct, earth element, armour 8. Bludgeoning attacks. Always fights alone. A heat spell blinds it (50% miss chance), a cold spell removes its dodge and 75% of its armour, a lightning spell speeds up its attacks by 65% and deals it 12 lightning damage each time its action bar fills; each lasts 8 s and does not stack. Level 4, in the Toll Collector’s Office. Drops iron scrap and the toll stamp.

name: Forest Rat
desc: Small basic beast. Bites for piercing damage. Appears in The Cages, the Vermin Hall, the Woods Edge, the Docks and the Forest Gate. Rare drop: Cloth Tunic.

name: Young Wolf
desc: Basic beast. Bites for piercing damage with a 20% chance to inflict Punctured. Drops fur and raw meat.

name: Wolf
desc: Veteran beast. Bites for piercing damage with a 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Drops fur and raw meat; rare drops include the Wolf Fang Blade and a Rune of Swiftness.

name: Bristleback Boar
desc: Large veteran beast. Bludgeoning charge with a 15% chance to inflict Concussed. Drops raw meat.

name: Cliff Hawk
desc: Veteran flying beast, wind element. Attacks from range for slashing damage with a 25% chance to inflict Bleeding. Rare drop: Hawk Feather Band.

name: Cave Spider
desc: Veteran vermin. Poison bite with a 35% chance to inflict Poison. Takes 50% less poison damage.

name: Stone Golem
desc: Large elite construct, earth element. Always met alone. Bludgeoning blows with a 25% chance to inflict Concussed. Takes 60% less slashing and piercing damage, 50% more bludgeoning and arcane damage. Two loot rolls; drops iron scrap and gold.

name: Cell Slime
desc: Training slime on floor 0. Every hit it lands deals exactly 1 damage. No armour and no resistances, so every starting weapon deals its listed damage. Appears in the Cellblock (once) and the Field (three fights). Drops Slime Gel.

name: Slime
desc: Small basic slime. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% less poison and 15% less cold damage, and 25% more bludgeoning damage. Appears in the Vermin Hall. Drops Slime Gel.

name: Cage-Bred Slime
desc: Small basic slime bred in The Cages to take the same damage from every type: no armour, no resistances. Bludgeoning attacks. Appears only in The Cages. Drops Slime Gel.

name: Suspiciously Large Slime
desc: Large basic slime, bred in The Cages like the Cage-Bred Slime: no armour, no resistances. Bludgeoning attacks. Appears only when the Cages keeper dares you: every 8 wins while you train there, until you beat it. The fight cannot be fled. Drops 2–4 Slime Gel.

name: Slimer
desc: Veteran slime. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% less poison and 15% less cold damage, and 25% more bludgeoning damage. Drops Slime Gel.

name: Slimest
desc: Large elite slime. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 50% less slashing and piercing damage, 30% less poison, 20% less cold, and 25% more bludgeoning damage. Two loot rolls of Slime Gel.

name: Ice Slime
desc: Basic slime, ice element. Cold attacks with a 40% chance to inflict Chilled. Takes 50% less cold and 25% more heat damage; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning.

name: Fire Slime
desc: Basic slime, fire element. Attacks from range for heat damage with a 30% chance to inflict On Fire. Takes 50% less heat and 50% more cold damage; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Drops Warm Slime Gel.

name: Flame Slime
desc: Veteran slime, fire element. Attacks from range for heat damage with a 35% chance to inflict On Fire. Takes 60% less heat and 60% more cold damage; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Drops Warm Slime Gel.

name: Pyre Slime
desc: Large elite slime, fire element. Attacks from range for heat damage with a 40% chance to inflict On Fire. Takes 70% less heat and 70% more cold damage; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Two loot rolls; drops Warm Slime Gel and gold.

name: Goblin
desc: Small basic goblin. Piercing attacks with a 15% chance to inflict Bleeding. Takes 10% less poison damage. Appears in The Cages and on floors 4 to 6. Drops fur and iron scrap.

name: Boss Goblin
desc: Legendary goblin. Slashing attacks. Always spawns in a group of five with Goblin escorts. Takes 25% less poison damage. Two loot rolls; drops include a Boss Token, Iron Gauntlets, the Moonlit Katana and greater runes.

name: Goblin Raid Leader
desc: Veteran goblin. Slashing attacks with a 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Pocket Sand, Dirty Stab and Gather. Always leads two Goblins. Takes 15% less poison damage. Floor 4's boss, at the Raid Camp. Two loot rolls.

name: Goblin Warchief
desc: Large elite goblin. Slashing attacks with a 25% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring, Dirty Stab and Gather. Always leads two escorts drawn from Witch Doctors, Firetongues and Hobgoblins. Takes 30% less poison and 20% less heat damage. Floor 6's boss, in the Great Hall; killing it opens prestige. Three loot rolls.

name: Goblin Firetongue
desc: Small basic goblin. Fights from range with arcane fire: "quickly fire pierce" and "fire pierce", which can set you On Fire. Takes 25% less heat and 10% less poison damage. Drops fur and iron scrap.

name: Goblin Witch Doctor
desc: Small veteran goblin. Fights from range with goblin miracles: heals its allies with Mud Poultice (twice a fight, only when it has allies), then casts Vermin Swarm and Cinder Curse. Takes 20% less poison damage. Drops fur.

name: Hobgoblin
desc: Veteran goblin. Slashing attacks with a 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Gather, Hamstring, Lunge, Dirty Stab and Pocket Sand; with martial open, seeing a technique used on you 50 times teaches it. Takes 15% less poison damage. Drops fur and iron scrap.

name: Hobgoblin Champion
desc: Large elite goblin. Slashing attacks with a 25% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Gather, Heavy Blow, Hamstring and Dirty Stab. Spawns with one Hobgoblin escort. Floor 5’s boss, at the Back Door. Takes 30% less poison and 20% less slashing damage. Three loot rolls; drops include a Boss Token, gold, Iron Gauntlets and the Moonlit Katana.

name: Slime Golem
desc: Gargantuan ancient slime construct, earth element. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 75% less slashing and piercing damage, 70% less heat and cold, 75% more bludgeoning and double arcane damage. Three loot rolls; drops Warm Slime Gel, gold and a Boss Token.

name: Water Slime
desc: Basic slime, water element. Bludgeoning attacks with a 40% chance to inflict Wet. Takes 60% less slashing and piercing, 40% less heat, 25% more bludgeoning and 60% more lightning damage. Appears in the Bog and the Docks. Drops Slime Gel and Chilled Slime Gel.

name: Algae Slime
desc: Basic slime, nature element. Poison attacks with a 30% chance to inflict Poison. Takes 60% less poison, 40% more heat; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Drops Slime Gel and Common Herb.

name: Honey Slime
desc: Small basic slime, nature element. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 50% less slashing and piercing, 35% less bludgeoning, and 50% more cold damage. Drops Slime Gel and Common Herb; rare drop: Herbal Charm.

name: Earth Slime
desc: Basic slime, earth element. Bludgeoning attacks with a 30% chance to inflict Shardbound. Takes 60% less slashing and piercing, 50% less lightning, 20% less cold, and 30% more bludgeoning damage. Drops Slime Gel and iron scrap.

name: Wind Slime
desc: Small basic slime, wind element. Attacks from range for wind damage with a 25% chance to inflict Dazzled. Takes 70% less piercing, 30% less slashing, 20% less bludgeoning, and 40% more lightning damage. Rare drop: Rune of Swiftness.

name: Spark Slime
desc: Small basic slime, lightning element. Attacks from range for lightning damage with a 35% chance to inflict Jolted. Takes 70% less lightning; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Drops Charged Slime Gel.

name: Tide Slime
desc: Veteran slime, water element. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 60% less slashing and piercing, 50% less heat, 25% more bludgeoning and 70% more lightning damage. Drops Chilled Slime Gel and Slime Gel.

name: Frost Slime
desc: Veteran slime, ice element. Cold attacks with a 45% chance to inflict Chilled. Takes 60% less cold and 40% more heat damage; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Drops Chilled Slime Gel; rare drop: Minor Rune of Frost.

name: Boulder Slime
desc: Large veteran slime, earth element. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 70% less slashing and piercing, 60% less lightning, 25% less cold, and 40% more bludgeoning damage. Drops iron scrap and Slime Gel.

name: Gale Slime
desc: Veteran slime, wind element. Attacks from range for wind damage. High DEX. Takes 75% less piercing, 30% less slashing, 30% less bludgeoning, and 50% more lightning damage. Rare drops: Hawk Feather Band, Rune of Swiftness.

name: Storm Slime
desc: Veteran slime, lightning element. Attacks from range for lightning damage. Takes 80% less lightning; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Drops Charged Slime Gel; rare drop: Minor Rune of Thunder.

name: Zombie Slime
desc: Veteran undead slime, toxic element. Poison attacks. Takes 80% less poison, 60% less piercing, 50% less slashing, and 25% more bludgeoning damage. Drops Slime Gel, ruined fur and iron scrap.

name: Slime Spider
desc: Small veteran slime vermin, toxic element. Poison attacks. Spawns in packs of 2 to 5. Takes 60% less poison, 50% less piercing, 40% less slashing, and 25% more bludgeoning damage. Appears in the Cave Mouth and the Hollows. Rare drop: Spider Silk Garb.

name: Coin Slime
desc: Medium veteran slime. Bludgeoning attacks. Always met alone. Higher DEX than other slimes. Takes 60% less slashing and piercing, 30% less arcane, 25% more bludgeoning and 40% more heat damage. Carries 20 to 60 gold and drops more; rare drop: Lucky Charm.

name: Slime Legionary
desc: Veteran humanoid slime. Piercing attacks. Escort of the Slime King. Takes 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning and 20% more arcane damage. Drops Slime Gel, iron scrap and Old Spear; rare drop: Wooden Shield.

name: Slime Skirmisher
desc: Veteran humanoid slime. Attacks from range for piercing damage. Escort of the Slime King. Takes 50% less slashing and piercing and 25% more bludgeoning damage. Drops Slime Gel; rare drop: Hunting Bow.

name: Glacier Slime
desc: Large elite slime, ice element. Cold attacks. Takes 80% less cold, 55% less slashing and piercing, 60% more heat and 25% more bludgeoning damage. Two loot rolls; drops Chilled Slime Gel; rare drops: Slime Core, Minor Rune of Frost.

name: Obsidian Slime
desc: Large elite slime, earth element. Slashing attacks. Takes 75% less piercing, 70% less lightning, 40% less slashing, 40% less heat, and 40% more bludgeoning damage. Two loot rolls; drops iron scrap; rare drops: Slime Core, Steel Greatsword.

name: Tempest Slime
desc: Elite slime, lightning element. Attacks from range for lightning damage. Takes 90% less lightning, 20% less arcane; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Two loot rolls; drops Charged Slime Gel; rare drops: Slime Core, Greater Rune of Thunder.

name: Arcane Slime
desc: Elite slime, arcane element. Attacks from range for arcane damage. Takes 70% less arcane, 20% less lightning; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Two loot rolls; drops Luminous Slime Gel; rare drops: Slime Core, Apprentice Ring, Oak Staff.

name: Radiant Slime
desc: Elite slime, light element. Arcane damage attacks. Takes 50% less arcane, 40% less heat; 50% less slashing and piercing, 25% more bludgeoning. Two loot rolls; drops Luminous Slime Gel; rare drops: Slime Core, Pilgrim Amulet, Greater Rune of Vitality.

name: Umbral Slime
desc: Elite incorporeal slime, dark element. Arcane damage attacks. Takes 85% less slashing and piercing, 50% less bludgeoning, and 50% more arcane damage. Two loot rolls; drops Void Slime Gel; rare drops: Slime Core, Spellwoven Cloak.

name: Metal Slime
desc: Small elite slime construct. Bludgeoning attacks. Always met alone. Highest DEX in the slime family. Takes 90% less slashing and piercing, 60% less bludgeoning, 50% less heat and cold, and 60% more lightning damage. 120 XP, 40 to 90 gold; drops iron ingots, gold and Slime Cores.

name: Slime Guardian
desc: Colossal ancient slime construct. Bludgeoning attacks. Always met alone. Takes 80% less slashing and piercing, 50% less heat and cold, 50% more bludgeoning and 60% more arcane damage. Three loot rolls; drops Slime Cores, iron ingots, a Boss Token, Iron Breastplate and Greater Rune of Vitality.

name: Slime King
desc: Large legendary slime, unique. Bludgeoning attacks. Spawns in a group of 3 to 5 with Slime Legionary and Slime Skirmisher escorts. Takes 65% less slashing and piercing, 40% less heat and cold, 30% more bludgeoning and 30% more arcane damage. Three loot rolls; drops Slime Cores, Luminous Slime Gel, a Boss Token, the Moonlit Katana, Iron Gauntlets and Greater Rune of Might.

name: Training Dummy
desc: Passive target at the Training Area; it never attacks. Spawns in groups of one, three or five so splash and flank behaviour can be tested. About 2,500 HP and 15% evasion. Takes 30% less slashing, piercing and bludgeoning damage; no elemental resistance. Dies and respawns; no loot. Practice target: reduced skill and attribute XP, no level XP.

name: Benchmark Post
desc: Passive post with about one million HP: it does not die within a session, so sustained damage can be read off it. No armour, 15% evasion, takes 30% less slashing, piercing and bludgeoning damage. Never attacks; no loot. Practice target: reduced skill and attribute XP, no level XP.

name: Reinforced Post
desc: Passive post with flat armour of exactly 100 and no resistances: every blow is reduced by 100, and a blow with less than 100 in it lands for the floor of 1. Penetration does nothing here; it answers resistances, not armour. About one million HP.

name: Swaying Post
desc: Passive post with evasion fixed at 35%, the hard cap on the stat: about one swing in three misses. No armour, no resistances. About one million HP.

name: Flopping Post
desc: The only post that attacks: about 23.5 damage a swing before your defences, at high speed, so the incoming side can be read: armour, resistances, dodge, parry, wards, crit reduction and size penalties. It also evades 35%, since the same DEX that sets its speed sets its dodge. No armour, about one million HP; you are not expected to kill it.

name: Warded Post
desc: Passive post that resists every elemental damage type at exactly 75% and no physical type at all. Compare a weapon hit with a spell hit to read the gap, and measure penetration against the 75% wall. No armour, about one million HP.

name: Mending Post
desc: Passive post that regenerates 0.1% of its health every tick, about 1,000 a tick or 10,000 a second; your damage must exceed that before its total moves. Heat or acid damage stops the regeneration. No armour, about one million HP.

name: Psionic Slime - Vermillion
desc: Large elite slime, fire element. Casts psionic workings from range for heat damage: a piercing single-target shape that cannot miss, then a wide multi-target sweep. Takes 80% less heat damage; no physical resistances. Carries 120 to 250 gold; no other loot yet.

name: Death Knight
desc: Medium veteran armoured humanoid, dark element. Fights with a sword first (Gather, then Heavy Blow) and casts dark arcane sentences when off balance. Holds a counterspell tuned against light and heat, which fires when you cast. Immune to poison; takes 80% less dark and 75% less cold damage; takes double light damage and 40% more heat and earth damage. No loot yet.

name: Giant Spider Queen
desc: Huge elite vermin, toxic element. Always fights alone. Poison bite with a 60% chance to inflict heavy Poison. Takes 40% less slashing, 50% less poison, 35% less earth and 20% less bludgeoning; takes 50% more piercing, 40% more heat and 20% more cold damage. 200 XP; rare drops: Spider Silk Garb, Lucky Charm.

name: Raider
desc: Veteran humanoid on floor 11. Slashing attacks with a 15% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Hamstring, Lunge and Gather. Drops iron scrap and leather.

name: Brute
desc: Large veteran humanoid on floor 11. Bludgeoning attacks. Fights with Heavy Blow and Gather. Drops iron scrap and hardwood.

name: Siege Captain
desc: Elite humanoid, the last fight of the stronghold’s wave. Spawns with a raider and a brute. Slashing attacks with a 20% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring, Dirty Stab and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, iron ingots and gold.

name: Corsair
desc: Elite humanoid. Spawns with a raider. Piercing attacks. Fights with Lunge, Dirty Stab and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, gold and leather.

name: Bandit Thug
desc: Basic humanoid bandit on floor 7, on the merchant road and in the salt-flats camp. Bludgeoning attacks. Fights with Heavy Blow and Gather. Drops gold, iron scrap and leather.

name: Bandit Archer
desc: Basic humanoid bandit on floor 7, on the merchant road and in the salt-flats camp, most of all on its watchtowers. Piercing attacks from range. Fights with Lunge and Gather. Drops gold, leather and iron scrap.

name: Bandit Cutthroat
desc: Veteran humanoid bandit on floor 7, on the merchant road and in the salt-flats camp. Slashing attacks. Fights with Pocket Sand, Dirty Stab and Gather. Drops gold, leather and iron scrap.

name: Bandit Chief
desc: Large elite humanoid, the bandits’ chief, in the camp’s tent on floor 7. Spawns with two escorts: thugs, archers or cutthroats. Slashing attacks. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring, Dirty Stab and Gather. Killing it clears floor 7. Drops a Boss Token, iron ingots and gold.

name: Camp Demon
desc: Huge ancient eldritch, dark element, in the burnt camp on floor 7: summoned into the bandits’ camp, it absorbed them. Present only while floor 7 is the last ward of the city left, for 24 in-game hours from the third ward’s clear. Always fights alone. Dark attacks. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring, Dirty Stab and Gather. Keeps half of the HP it loses in a fight it survives. Takes 50% less dark and 20% less heat damage; takes 40% more light damage. Killing it clears floor 7. Drops a Boss Token, gold and iron ingots.

name: Rogue Beast
desc: Large elite beast, floor 8’s keeper while one or none of the other wards is cleared: the beast before its change. Always met alone. Slashing attacks with a 20% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Hamstring, Lunge and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, pristine fur and meat.

name: Rogue Beast, Final Form
desc: Huge elite beast, floor 8’s keeper once two or more of the other wards are cleared: the beast after its change. Always met alone. About a third more health and a quarter more strength than the young form at the same level. Slashing attacks with a 30% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring, Lunge and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, pristine fur and meat.

name: Death Squire
desc: Medium veteran armoured humanoid, dark element: floor 9’s keeper while one or none of the other wards is cleared, and a hunt in the Barrow Fields. Fights with a sword first (Gather, then Heavy Blow) and casts gloom cut when off balance; no counterspell. Takes 75% less poison, 50% less dark and cold, 30% more heat and 75% more light damage. Drops a Boss Token, bone dust and iron scrap.

name: Ore Eater, Stage 1
art: Insects Giant Bug Death Worm A.png
desc: Medium elite vermin, earth element: floor 10’s keeper when none of the other wards is cleared. Always met alone. Bludgeoning attacks. Armoured shell; takes 30% less slashing and piercing and 35% more bludgeoning damage. Fights with Heavy Blow and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, copper ore and iron scrap.

name: Ore Eater, Stage 2
desc: Large elite vermin, earth element: floor 10’s keeper when one of the other wards is cleared. Always met alone. Bludgeoning attacks with a 15% chance to inflict Concussed. Thicker shell than stage 1; takes 35% less slashing and piercing and 40% more bludgeoning damage. Fights with Heavy Blow and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, copper ore, tin ore and iron scrap.

name: Ore Eater, Stage 3
art: Insects Giant Bug Death Worm B.png
desc: Huge elite vermin, earth element: floor 10’s keeper when two of the other wards are cleared. Always met alone. Bludgeoning attacks with a 20% chance to inflict Concussed. Thicker shell than stage 2; takes 40% less slashing and piercing and 45% more bludgeoning damage. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, copper ore, tin ore and iron scrap.

name: Ore Eater, Stage 4
desc: Gargantuan elite vermin, earth element: floor 10’s keeper when all three other wards are cleared. Always met alone. Bludgeoning attacks with a 25% chance to inflict Concussed. The thickest shell; takes 50% less slashing and piercing and 50% more bludgeoning damage. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, copper ore, tin ore and iron scrap.

name: Reef Eel
desc: Basic sea monster on the harbor band’s waters. Piercing bite with a 15% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Lunge and Gather. The navy’s and the merchants’ prey. Drops bone dust and biomatter.

name: Deep Serpent
desc: Veteran sea monster on the harbor band’s waters. Bludgeoning attacks. Fights with Heavy Blow and Gather. The navy’s and the merchants’ prey. Drops bone dust and biomatter.

name: Brood Matron
desc: Named ship of the sea beast’s brood: a once-only fight on floors 12 and 13 for the navy and the merchants, and the Sea Beast’s escort on floor 14. Bludgeoning attacks, 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring and Gather.

name: The Sea Beast
desc: Elite sea monster, the navy’s mission boss on floor 14. Spawns with four Brood Matrons. Bludgeoning attacks, 20% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, biomatter and bone dust.

name: Cutthroat
desc: Basic pirate on the harbor band’s waters. Slashing attacks. Fights with Pocket Sand, Dirty Stab and Gather. The privateers’ and the merchants’ prey. Drops gold, leather and iron scrap.

name: Pirate Gunner
desc: Veteran pirate on the harbor band’s waters. Piercing attacks. Fights with Lunge, Finishing Cut and Gather. The privateers’ and the merchants’ prey. Drops gold and iron scrap.

name: Pirate Captain
desc: Named pirate ship: a once-only fight on floors 12 and 13 for the privateers and the merchants, and an escort of the Pirate King and of the Warden of the Closed Port on floor 14. Slashing attacks, 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Crosscut, Dirty Stab, Finishing Cut and Gather.

name: The Pirate King
desc: Elite pirate, the privateers’ mission boss on floor 14. Spawns with four Pirate Captains. Slashing attacks, 25% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Heavy Blow, Crosscut, Finishing Cut and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, gold and bronze ingots.

name: Convoy Guard
desc: Basic guard on the harbor band’s convoys. Slashing attacks. Fights with Crosscut and Gather. The pirates’ prey. Drops gold, leather and iron scrap.

name: Marine
desc: Veteran navy marine escorting the harbor band’s convoys. Piercing attacks. Fights with Lunge, Hamstring and Gather. The pirates’ prey. Drops gold, iron scrap and leather.

name: Frigate Captain
desc: Named navy ship: a once-only fight on floors 12 and 13 for the pirates, and an escort of the treasure galleon on floor 14. Slashing attacks. Fights with Crosscut, Lunge, Finishing Cut and Gather.

name: Master of the Treasure Galleon
desc: Elite, the pirates’ mission boss on floor 14: the treasure galleon’s master. Spawns with four Frigate Captains. Slashing attacks. Fights with Heavy Blow, Crosscut, Finishing Cut and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, gold and bronze ingots.

name: Warden of the Closed Port
desc: Elite, the merchants’ mission boss on floor 14: the raider who holds the closed port. Spawns with four Pirate Captains. Bludgeoning attacks. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, gold and iron ingots.

name: Room Brawler
desc: Humanoid in the Vermin Festival’s dark room. Slashing attacks with a 15% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Hamstring, Lunge and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Room Bruiser
desc: Large humanoid in the Vermin Festival’s dark room. Bludgeoning attacks. Fights with Heavy Blow and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Last of the Room
desc: Elite humanoid: the last of the dark room’s nine, always fought alone. Beating it clears floor 15. Slashing attacks with a 20% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring, Dirty Stab and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Survivor Blade
desc: Humanoid on the Vermin Festival’s royale field, a survivor of another room. Piercing attacks with a 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Lunge, Dirty Stab, Pocket Sand and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Survivor Brute
desc: Large humanoid on the Vermin Festival’s royale field, a survivor of another room. Bludgeoning attacks. Fights with Heavy Blow, Crosscut and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Champion of the Field
desc: Elite humanoid: the last survivor on the royale field, always fought alone. Beating it wins the festival. Slashing attacks with a 25% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Crosscut, Finishing Cut, Heavy Blow, Hamstring and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Nest Harpy
desc: Beast in the harpy nest on the Vermin Festival’s royale field, met in twos. Slashing attacks with a 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Lunge, Hamstring and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Pool Serpent
desc: Beast in the serpent pool under the royale field’s waterfall. Piercing bite with a 30% chance to inflict Poison. Fights with Lunge, Dirty Stab and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Den Wolf
desc: Beast in the wolf den in the royale field’s forest, met in threes. Piercing bite with a 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Lunge, Hamstring and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Cave Bear
desc: Large beast in the bear cave on the royale field. Bludgeoning attacks with a 15% chance to inflict Concussed. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Yard Hound
desc: Beast in the hound yard of the royale field’s village, met in twos. Piercing bite with a 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Fights with Lunge, Hamstring and Gather. Drops nothing.

name: Scree Slime
desc: Large elite earth slime on floor 17. Slashing attacks. Takes 40% less slashing, 75% less piercing, 70% less lightning and 40% less heat damage; takes 15% more bludgeoning. Drops iron scrap and sometimes a Slime Core.

name: Rime Slime
desc: Large elite ice slime on floor 17. Cold attacks with a 40% chance to inflict Chilled. Takes 55% less slashing and piercing and 80% less cold damage; takes 60% more heat and 15% more bludgeoning. Drops chilled slime gel and sometimes a Slime Core. Met in snow.

name: Cinder Slime
desc: Large elite fire slime on floor 17. Ranged heat attacks with a 40% chance to inflict heavy On Fire. Takes 50% less slashing and piercing and 70% less heat damage; takes 70% more cold and 15% more bludgeoning. Drops warm slime gel and sometimes a Slime Core. Met in a heatwave.

name: Squall Slime
desc: Elite wind slime on floor 17. Ranged wind attacks. Takes 30% less slashing and bludgeoning and 75% less piercing damage; takes 50% more lightning. Drops slime gel and sometimes a Slime Core or a Hawk Feather Band. Met in a gale.

name: Storm Slime
desc: Elite lightning slime on floor 17. Ranged lightning attacks with a 35% chance to inflict Jolted. Takes 50% less slashing and piercing, 90% less lightning and 20% less arcane damage; takes 15% more bludgeoning. Drops charged slime gel and sometimes a Slime Core. Met in a storm.

name: Downpour Slime
desc: Large elite water slime on floor 17. Bludgeoning attacks with a 40% chance to inflict Wet. Takes 60% less slashing and piercing and 50% less heat damage; takes 70% more lightning and 15% more bludgeoning. Drops slime gel, chilled slime gel and sometimes a Slime Core. Met in rain.

name: Ridge Goblin
desc: Small basic goblin on floor 17, met in the pack of a Ridge Goblin Chief. Piercing attacks with a 20% chance to inflict Bleeding. Drops fur and iron scrap.

name: Ridge Goblin Chief
desc: Veteran goblin on floor 17. Spawns in a group of 3 to 5 with Ridge Goblin escorts. Slashing attacks with a 25% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Pocket Sand, Dirty Stab and Gather. Drops fur, iron scrap, rarely a Boss Token.

name: Deep Spider
desc: Veteran vermin in the caves of floor 17. Poison bite with a 35% chance to inflict Poison. Takes 50% less poison damage. Rarely drops Spider Silk Garb or a Lucky Charm.

name: Brood Queen
desc: Huge elite vermin, the nest queen of floor 17. Always fights alone. Poison bite with a 60% chance to inflict heavy Poison. Takes 40% less slashing, 50% less poison, 35% less earth and 20% less bludgeoning; takes 50% more piercing, 40% more heat and 20% more cold damage. Three loot rolls; drops a Boss Token, Spider Silk Garb, Lucky Charm and gold. No gate reads her.

name: Peak Guardian
desc: Colossal ancient slime construct, the guardian of floor 17’s peak. Bludgeoning attacks. Always fights alone, and again whenever you hunt at the peak. Takes 80% less slashing and piercing, 50% less heat and cold and 20% more bludgeoning damage, 60% more arcane. Its first kill opens the way down to the base. Three loot rolls; drops Slime Cores, iron ingots, a Boss Token, an Iron Breastplate and a Greater Rune of Vitality.

name: Slime Regent
desc: Large legendary slime, the gate boss of floor 17. Spawns in a group of 3 with Regent’s Legionary escorts, two levels below it or more. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 65% less slashing and piercing, 40% less heat and cold, 15% more bludgeoning and 30% more arcane damage. Its first kill clears floor 17. Three loot rolls; drops Slime Cores, Luminous Slime Gel, a Boss Token, the Moonlit Katana, Iron Gauntlets and a Greater Rune of Might.

name: Regent’s Legionary
desc: Veteran slime soldier, the escort of the gate boss on floor 17. Piercing attacks. Takes 50% less slashing and piercing, 15% more bludgeoning, 20% more arcane damage. Drops slime gel and iron scrap.

name: Ridge Wolf
desc: Elite beast, levels 46 to 48. Piercing attacks with a 30% chance to inflict heavy Bleeding. Fights with Lunge, Hamstring and Gather. Met in groups of 2 or 3 on the open ground of floor 17 in still weather; drops Ridge Amber and fur.

name: Cairn Brute
desc: Large elite construct, levels 46 to 48. Bludgeoning attacks with a 30% chance to inflict Concussed. Takes 60% less slashing and piercing, 15% more bludgeoning, 30% more arcane damage. Fights with Heavy Blow and Gather. Met in groups of 2 or 3 on the open ground of floor 17 in still weather; drops Ridge Amber and iron scrap.

name: Hollow Seer
desc: Elite humanoid caster, levels 46 to 48. Ranged dark attacks; casts Gloom and Cut. Takes 50% less dark and 30% less poison damage. Met in groups of 2 or 3 on the open ground of floor 17 in still weather; drops Ridge Amber and gold.

name: Scarab
desc: Vermin of the desert band, floors 18 to 20. Piercing attacks. Fights with Gather and Lunge. Killed by heat it can drop brimstone; killed by bludgeoning, copper ore. Sometimes drops gold leaf.

name: Cobra
desc: Beast of the desert band. Piercing bite with a 30% chance to inflict Poison. Takes 30% less poison damage. Fights with Lunge, Dirty Stab and Gather. Killed by a blade (slashing or piercing) it can drop leather; killed by heat, green vitriol. Sometimes drops raw meat.

name: Giant Scorpion
desc: Vermin of the desert band. Piercing sting with a 25% chance to inflict Poison. Takes 40% less poison damage. Fights with Hamstring, Crosscut and Gather. Killed by bludgeoning it can drop tin ore; killed by heat, fixing salt.

name: Mummy
desc: Undead of the desert band. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 50% more heat damage and 50% less poison damage. Fights with Heavy Blow and Gather. Two drop rolls: killed by heat it can drop bone ash, killed by bludgeoning bone dust; any other kill drops neither.

name: Sand Colossus
desc: Construct, floor 18’s forecourt guardian. Always fights alone. Bludgeoning attacks. Takes 90% less heat damage. Fights with Heavy Blow and Gather. Drops a Boss Token, gold, copper ore and tin ore; killed by bludgeoning it can also drop quicksilver.

name: Sabaket
desc: Sabaket, the Weigher at the Door: the judge of floor 19’s pyramid. Always fights alone. Slashing attacks with a 25% chance to inflict Bleeding. Takes 50% less dark and 30% less poison damage. Fights with Heavy Blow, Hamstring, Finishing Cut and Gather. With nothing taken from the treasury it is weaker than the floor’s dens; each grave good taken raises its level, up to the band’s strongest. Drops a Boss Token, gold, bronze ingots and quicksilver.

name: Roadstead Crew
desc: Crew of the ferry at floor 20’s roadstead. Always three at once. Piercing attacks. Fights with Lunge, Dirty Stab, Pocket Sand and Gather. Drops gold, leather and sometimes a Boss Token.
